question: A reader says every picture is only decoration. Which example best challenges that claim?
audio_prompt: A reader says every picture is only decoration. Which example best challenges that claim?

answers.text: A map image shows which path reaches the exit.
A border repeats dots around a page.
A blank margin surrounds a title.

explanation.summary: A route map communicates information needed to act, rather than merely decorating the text.
